name: Nmbr9 Constraint Programming Challenge
description: Modern board games are a rich source of interesting and new challenges for combinatorial problems. The game Nmbr9 is a solitaire style puzzle game using polyominoes. The rules of the game are simple to explain, but modelling the game effectively using constraint programming is hard. This abstract presents the game, contributes new generalized variants of the game suitable for benchmarking and testing, and describes a model for the presented variants. The question of the top possible score in the standard game is an open challenge.
reputation: A niche constraint-programming benchmark used by researchers interested in combinatorial puzzle modelling; limited broader adoption outside CP research.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on combinatorial optimization; small / specialized problem instances; open challenge (best possible score unknown) so saturation is unlikely; low contamination risk for ML models.
